whatsappMessage:
Hi Beauty Studio by Dibya team,

I noticed your salon has exceptional 4.7★ reviews with 150+ happy clients in Kumhrar, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page.

Maine aapke beauty studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, bridal/makeup service menu, aur client gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/dibya

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Beauty Studio by Dibya team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and a mobile-friendly showcase for your beauty services in Kumhrar, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
